about: Routing test set for the Ask box. Each question carries the category it should be routed to; `secondary` is set only where a question genuinely has two halves. `seen` questions may be used while tuning prompts or as fine-tuning data; `new` questions never are — they are the only honest measure of whether a change helped, and tuning on them destroys that. Many questions name deals, products and places we do not trade in yet (Gujarat organic cotton, recycled polyester, denim, Bangladesh buyers): routing must not depend on the data that happens to be loaded today, only on which source could answer. Scored by scripts/eval_classify.py.
